title: Lord make me an instrument

lines.text: I lift up my hands in Your Name.
I'll sing You a love song,
I'll lift up my hands in Your Name
I'll sing You a love song,
I lift up my hands in Your Name.
We lift up our hands in Your Name.
All glory and honour to Jesus forever,
We lift up our hands to Your Name.

chords:
[Verse]
[F]Lord, make me an [Bb]instrument,
An [F]instrument of [C]worship,
I [F]lift up my [Bb]hands in [C]Your [F]Name.
(Repeat)

[Verse]
I'll sing You a love song,
A [F]love song of [Bb]wor[C]ship,
I'll lift up my hands in Your Name
I'll sing You a love song,
A [F]love song to [Bb]Je[C]sus,
I lift up my hands in Your Name.

[Verse]
For [F]we are a [Bb]sympho[F]ny,
A [F]symphony of [Bb]wor[C]ship,
We [F]lift up our [Bb]hands in [C]Your [F]Name.
(Repeat)

[Verse]
[F]All glory and [Bb]honour to [F]Jesus for[C]ever,
We [F]lift up our [Bb]hands to [C]Your [F]Name.
(Repeat)
lyrics:
[Verse]
Lord, make me an instrument,
An instrument of worship,
I lift up my hands in Your Name.
(Repeat)

[Verse]
I'll sing You a love song,
A love song of worship,
I'll lift up my hands in Your Name
I'll sing You a love song,
A love song to Jesus,
I lift up my hands in Your Name.

[Verse]
For we are a symphony,
A symphony of worship,
We lift up our hands in Your Name.
(Repeat)

[Verse]
All glory and honour to Jesus forever,
We lift up our hands to Your Name.
(Repeat)
